afirmacion: Commerce encontro subsidios compensables a productores y exportadores marroquies
cita_textual: countervailable subsidies are being provided to producers and exporters of phosphate fertilizers from the Kingdom of Morocco

afirmacion: La USITC concluyo que una industria de EE.UU. esta materialmente danada por las importaciones
cita_textual: an industry in the United States is materially injured by reason of imports of phosphate fertilizers from Morocco and Russia

tema: Objetivo de la suspension del CVD (EE.UU.)
afirmacion: Asegurar oferta suficiente y oportuna de fertilizantes fosfatados para los agricultores
cita_textual: Immediate action is necessary and appropriate to ensure in the interim that United States farmers have access to a sufficient and timely supply of phosphate fertilizers during the planting and growing season.

afirmacion: La investigacion se abrio por peticion de un productor de EE.UU., The Mosaic Company
cita_textual: in response to a petition filed on June 26, 2020, by The Mosaic Company, Plymouth, Minnesota.
emisor: USITC, aviso de inicio de las investigaciones 701-TA-650-651

tema: Industria protegida por el CVD de EE.UU.
afirmacion: Tres empresas (Mosaic, Nutrien y Simplot) concentran la gran mayoria de la produccion de EE.UU.; Mosaic es la principal
cita_textual: During the POI, three firms - Mosaic, Nutrien, and Simplot - accounted for the vast majority of all known U.S. production of phosphate fertilizers, with Mosaic the leading producer.
emisor: USITC, Phosphate Fertilizers from Morocco and Russia (Remand), Pub. 5490

tema: Votacion de la USITC sobre el CVD
afirmacion: La USITC voto 4 a 1 que hubo dano; el comisionado Johanson voto en contra
cita_textual: Commissioner David S. Johanson voted in the negative.
